lens_summary: Removal is a real breaking change for any external/fork/mirrored CI that runs the archive-orphan crate. ADR-0118 supplies a replacement pointer and rejected-alternatives, but bypasses ADR-0108's canonical 30/90 window without an explicit waiver and the CHANGELOG fails to flag the change as breaking. Retirement is defensible (one-time cutover hygiene); the migration HYGIENE is not.
